# FG-CLI-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_broken_input_is_an_input_failure` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 入力を読めませんでした。gstn を起動したプログラム（AI エージェントの MCP クライアントなど）を確かめてください。
- en: The input could not be read. Check the program that started gstn (an AI agent's MCP client, for example).
- id: Masukan tidak dapat dibaca. Periksa program yang menjalankan gstn (misalnya klien MCP agen AI).

## 原因 (cause)

`gstn mcp` (M3 X5) reads JSON-RPC messages from stdin and the read failed with an I/O error other than the end of input (a closed pipe or an unexpected end of file end the server cleanly with exit 0). The MCP client's transport broke: the process that started gstn went away abnormally, or stdin is something unreadable. Nothing on the server is affected. Also `gstn doc fmt` / `gstn doc lint` (plan 13 stage 2, local only) when the working tree cannot be read: `reason=cwd_unreadable` (the current directory), `reason=git_ls_files_failed` (`git ls-files` in the repository's root is not runnable, fails, or passes its 30 s limit: git_not_runnable, exit <n>, git_timeout), or `reason=file_unreadable` (a listed document or type definition cannot be opened or read; a file deleted from the working tree is passed over, not an error). Also `gstn part import` (plan 16 A6, local only) when a source cannot be read: `reason=import_unreadable` / `import_file_unreadable` / `import_file_too_large` (with `kind`), `import_no_claude_dir` (`--format claude` needs `.claude/` under `--from`), `import_path_not_utf8`, `import_too_many_entries` (more than 1000 in one directory), `only_unknown_slug` (a `--only` slug no source produced), `declare_from_scan_not_allowed` (only exec, network and fs-write may be declared from the scan); reading a skill or rules directory, like `gstn agent verify --part`, says `part_unreadable` / `part_too_large` / `part_too_deep`.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The detail line carries `reason=stdin_unreadable` and `kind` (the I/O error kind); for gstn doc, the reason above and `kind`: run `git ls-files` in the repository yourself and check the file's permissions. Look at the MCP client's own log for why its pipe failed; run `gstn mcp < /dev/null` to see that gstn itself starts and ends cleanly.

## 対処 (fix)

Restart the MCP client. If it keeps failing, check that the client starts gstn with a pipe on stdin (stdio transport), not a terminal or a file it closes.
